sources: https://cedarcreekcampgroundny.com/rates/ (page modified 2024-03-27 per the site's wp-json)

values.note: Water + electric $35 a night, full hook-up $40; tent (no hookups) $20. Weekly, monthly and seasonal ($1,250 base) rates also posted.

fees.source: https://cedarcreekcampgroundny.com/rates/ ('Full Hook-Up – $40.00 per night / $250.00 per week / $700.00 per month. Water and Electric – $35.00 per night ... Tent (No Hook-Ups) – $20.00 per night'; 'SEASONAL SITES Base price is $1250.00 per season'), page modified 2024-03-27 (wp-json), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Most sites have water, electric and sewer. Air conditioning may be run only at the few 30-amp sites, or from your own generator.

hookups.source: https://cedarcreekcampgroundny.com/ammenities/ ('most with water, electric and sewer hookups') + https://cedarcreekcampgroundny.com/rates/ ('Full Hook-Up – $40.00 per night'; '*Campers are unable to use air conditioning unless you bring a generator, unless you have a 30 amp site*') + https://cedarcreekcampgroundny.com/reservations/ ('We do have a few sites that do allow A/C usage'), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://cedarcreekcampgroundny.com/ammenities/ ('a full service campground with 175 sites on 86 acres of private property. There are open and wooded sites'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://cedarcreekcampgroundny.com/ammenities/ ('Camping comfort is provided by flush toilets, hot showers and a laundromat. The camp store is well stocked'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Summer camping season May through October (no dates posted).

season.source: https://cedarcreekcampgroundny.com/rates/ ('Summer Camping Season May through October'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservation inquiry by phone (315-376-4345), email or the site's form; no online booking.

booking.source: https://cedarcreekcampgroundny.com/reservations/ ('Reservation Inquiry ... Ask us about our availability. Phone: 315-376-4345'), read 2026-10-21

note: Lowville (Tug Hill), minutes from the Black River; 86 acres of open-field and wooded sites, seasonal sites among them. Swim/fishing pond, ATV-friendly. --Claude
summary: Operator site (rates page modified 2024-03-27): W/E $35, full hook-up $40 (confirmed), 175 sites, water true. Changed sewer false -> true ('most with water, electric and sewer hookups', full hook-up sites priced). Added 30-amp electric with the A/C-only-at-30-amp-sites caveat, showers, flush toilets, laundry, camp store, season May-October (no dates), phone/email booking. Under the $50 gate; working site with phone. Long-stay tests pass: nightly, weekly and monthly rates posted beside $1,250 seasonals, nothing for sale. Note corrected ('from $30', 'no full hookups') and trimmed of site/price/hookup/rating text.
